headlines.title: Raw Milk Cheese Linked to E. Coli Outbreak, Recalled Nationwide: See the Full List
headlines.description: Cheese made with raw milk is being recalled nationwide after public health officials linked it to an E. coli outbreak that’s sickened people in nine states.

headlines.title: Is Jam Healthy? Dietitians Reveal the No. 1 Type With the Most Benefits — and Which to Avoid
headlines.description: Jams are delicious and sweet, but are these fruit spreads healthy? Dietitians share the healthiest types of jams, which to avoid and nutritious jam pairings.

headlines.title: Simone Biles Addresses Recent Health Issues, Opens Up About Eczema Journey
headlines.description: Simone Biles talks with TODAY.com about her recent health issues, including the two inflammatory skin conditions she was diagnosed with this year.

headlines.title: Looming changes to Medicaid work requirements spark concern with patients and caregivers
headlines.description: New Medicaid work requirements are set to take effect at the beginning of 2027 and the non-partisan Congressional Budget Office says the changes could leave 8 million more people across the country without health insurance. It has patients and caregivers concerned about their futures. NBC News' Julie Tsirkin reports.

headlines.title: End-Of-Year Doctor Appointments: How to Get One, What to Say
headlines.description: The final months of the year are approaching, so it’s time to squeeze in end-of-year doctor's appointments. Family physician Dr. Jen Caudle stops by TODAY with tips on how to get the most out of your appointments, including getting the appointment, knowing when to get a second opinion, bringing a list of symptoms to your appointment, and more.

headlines.title: How to Prepare to Fall Sports and Avoid Getting Sidelined by Injury
headlines.description: Fall sports are in full swing, so Dr. Melissa Leber, associate professor of orthopedics and emergency medicine at Mount Sinai, joins the 3rd Hour of TODAY with tips to for preventing injuries, including the benefits of cross-training, making sure shoes from prior seasons still fit properly, when to seek medical attention and more.

headlines.title: Doctors in Pennsylvania estimate at least six babies have been born with measles
headlines.description: At least six babies in Pennsylvania have been born infected with measles, with two so sick they had to be admitted to intensive care. The growing outbreak is raising alarm among doctors who are treating the potentially deadly condition. Congenital measles is a disease that’s rarely, if ever, seen in the U.S. NBC News' Erika Edwards reports.

headlines.title: Shark dropped this self-cleaning vacuum by $130, shoppers love it because ‘it really sucks’
headlines.description: Shark’s popular Navigator Lift-Away upright multi-surface vacuum is more than $100 off on Amazon. It’s the perfect appliance for those who prefer upright vacuums that tackle pet hair.

headlines.title: Your winter emergency car kit isn’t complete without this item
headlines.description: To learn more about how to shop for and use a windshield scraper for ice and snow, and whether or not they can damage your windshield, I spoke with auto glass repair experts for their guidance.

headlines.title: New early October Prime Day deals just dropped — I hand-picked 41+ actually worth shopping
headlines.description: Prime Big Deal Days is back from October 6 to 7, and we’re already shopping early deals. Find editor-approved markdowns on iRobot, Ninja, Casper, Lego and more.

headlines.title: The best first aid kits to have on hand for non-hospital emergencies
headlines.description: I rounded up the best first aid kits to use during small emergencies and to treat injuries at home. Doctors also recommend how to shop for them.

headlines.title: An Orthopedic Surgeon’s No. 1 Test of Balance and Mobility for Healthy Aging
headlines.description: Dr. Jocelyn Wittstein, an orthopedic surgeon, reveals the at-home test you can do to maintain your mobility and work on your balance as you age.
